s15_ARB.articles-v1-f1: I live in an apartment in Cairo with my family. The apartment has a small balcony and a nice view.
s15_ARB.articles-v1-f2: Yesterday I went to the market and bought a apple and some bread. The bread was very fresh.
s15_ARB.articles-v2-f1: My school is a big building near the river. The library in the school has an old clock on the wall.
s15_ARB.articles-v2-f2: I like Alexandria because it is a beautiful city by the sea. The weather there is nice in the summer.

s10_ARB.copula-v1-f1: My friend Omar is a engineer. Today he is happy because he is play football.
s10_ARB.copula-v1-f2: The market is very big and busy. The people is friendly there.
s10_ARB.copula-v2-f1: My best friend is Ahmed and he is a student. Today he is tired.
s10_ARB.copula-v2-f2: My street is small and quiet. The houses is old but nice.

s0_LE.articles-v1-f1: I have big family. My father is engineer and my mother is teacher.
s0_LE.articles-v1-f2: Yesterday I go to market and buy an apple. I eat it in house.
s0_LE.articles-v2-f1: My school is big school. I have good teacher there.
s0_LE.articles-v2-f2: I like Cairo, it is big city. There is an old mosque and nice river.

s6_ARB.articles-v1-f1: I live in a flat in Giza with my family. My brother is a student and he has an old car.
s6_ARB.articles-v1-f2: Yesterday I bought new phone from shop. I also ate an orange.
s6_ARB.articles-v2-f1: My school is big school. We have a good library.
s6_ARB.articles-v2-f2: I like Alexandria because it is beautiful city. There is an old castle near sea.

s12_LE.articles-v1-f1: I live in a small house with my family. My sister is an engineer.
s12_LE.articles-v1-f2: Yesterday I went to a cafe with my friend. The coffee was very good.
s12_LE.articles-v2-f1: My school has a big garden. The teachers in the school are very kind.
s12_LE.articles-v2-f2: I like Luxor, it is beautiful city. It has an old temple near the river.
